governance_rules: remote SHA / protected refs > checkpoint gate + manifest > execution ledger > executor report > chat memory
remote SHA is the remote integration authority, NOT local worktree existence authority.
Verification levels freeze: REPORT_ONLY -> VERIFIED_LOCAL_EVIDENCE -> REMOTE_INTEGRATED -> GATE_VERIFIED. Only GATE_VERIFIED may be drawn as formal green.
A feature branch push is not REMOTE_INTEGRATED; it is recorded separately as remote_feature_pushed=true.
REAL_E2E_TRACK status must come from the authoritative remote or a machine-verifiable E2E gate; chat-level completion claims are never sufficient.
